steps.script: function setVal(sel, val){ var sec = document.querySelector('#concept-Recebimento'); var el = sec.querySelector(sel); if(!el) return 'MISSING:'+sel; var proto = el.tagName==='SELECT' ? window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype : window.HTMLInputElement.prototype; var setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, 'value').set; setter.call(el, val); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); return 'OK'; } var r = {}; r.entidadeId = setVal('input[name="entidadeId"]', '2b77172e-6f8f-4ea7-8541-4ee09b930862'); r.dataRecebimento = setVal('input[name="dataRecebimento"]', '2026-07-31'); r.estagio = setVal('select[name="estagio"]', 'PreRecebimento'); r.situacao = setVal('select[name="situacao"]', 'Suspenso'); var sec = document.querySelector('#concept-Recebimento'); var btn = Array.from(sec.querySelectorAll('button')).find(function(b){ return b.textContent.trim() === 'Create' || b.textContent.trim() === 'Save'; }); btn.click(); return JSON.stringify(r);

steps.name: apply_multiclause_filter
steps.script: var inputs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input')); var byIdx = {}; var text = document.body.innerText; var idxSit = text.indexOf('situacao:'); var idxEst = text.indexOf('estagio:'); function setVal(el, val){ var setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(el, val); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('keyup', {bubbles:true})); } if (inputs.length < 3) return 'ONLY_' + inputs.length + '_INPUTS'; setVal(inputs[1], 'Normal'); setVal(inputs[2], 'PreRecebimento'); return 'filled situacao input[1]=Normal, estagio input[2]=PreRecebimento';
